title: Tumi a Ɛnyɛ Den no
intro: Wɔ tete nsase so no, bere bi na tumidi bi a ɔwɔ tumi di tumi, na ɔhyɛɛ nneɛma akɛse ne ankorankoro a wontumi nkan wɔn nkwa. Ɛmfa ho sɛnkyerɛnne ne kɔkɔbɔ ahorow a emu da hɔ no, sodifo yi paw ɔkwan bi a ɔbɛfa so asɔre atia, na ɛde akasakasa a emu dɔ a ɛbɛka wɔ bere mu bae.
clues: Mekae sɛ mewɔ tumi ne tumi a etwa to wɔ tumidi kɛse bi so.
Mekasa tiaa ɔbɔfo bi a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase a ahemman nyinaa Awurade somaa no.
Ná wonim me nkurɔfo sɛ wonim adan akɛse ne asubɔnten a ɛma yɛn anibuei kɔ so tra hɔ no yiye.
Na meyɛ anwonwade nsɛnkyerɛnne pii ho adanse, a poma a ɛdannan ɔwɔ ne nsa a ɛhyerɛn hyerɛn ka ho.
Mepowee sɛ mɛma nnipa kuw bi a wɔayɛ nkoa afi m’asase so, ɛmfa ho sɛ na ɔsoro ahyɛde ahorow no.
Nnipa a wɔrefi hɔ no akyi a midii no maa me ne m’asraafo kɔɔ po bi a emu apaapae mu.

verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
